decision.reason: [ev-a6197708b375] says only that per-broker storage class overrides are "not supported anymore" and that users "should instead use multiple KafkaNodePool resources". It does not say what happens to an existing configuration that still uses them. They could be silently ignored (setting-ignored), rejected by validation (resource-rejected), or something that blocks reconciliation or the upgrade. The rest of the section doesn't settle this either: unlike [ev-4c2676e4665a], it gives no "make sure before upgrading" instruction that would support migration-required. To decide the kind, we need the upgrade guide or CRD/schema diff showing whether the overrides field was removed and how the operator treats it when it is still set.
